name: Screenshot
description: Capture a screen / window image — into the chat, onto the clipboard, or back to the agent as a visible image or OCR text.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: Browser builds prompt for getDisplayMedia permission; some browsers gate this behind HTTPS. The native capture mode and the host clipboard bridge are desktop-only.

mobile.reason: No getDisplayMedia / screen capture in the mobile WebView.

commands.name: /screenshot
commands.description: Capture a screen image into the chat and copy it to the clipboard. Pass `native` for a prompt-free desktop capture.
